publisher: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, National Organic Program
ownership: Official Organic INTEGRITY certified-operation information supplied by USDA-accredited certifying agents and published by USDA AMS
license_status: The USDA Ag Data Commons catalog record labels this dataset U.S. Public Domain, but this connector does not treat that catalog label as a standalone production-redistribution approval. API terms, attribution, and an explicit governance admission remain required.
source_access: The official API permits public-data retrieval with a required data.gov API key and states a default limit of 1,000 requests per hour per key. This version records that contract by endpoint and named credential only; it creates no credential, reads no credential value, and makes zero API record requests. The existing metadata path makes one bounded GET of the official history HTML and zero workbook requests. A separately acknowledged offline path accepts an operator-supplied SHA-256-pinned XLSX inside datahub; the live workbook schema is unverified and the exact sheet/header profile is conformance-only.
allowed_use: bounded validation of the exact official history page and extraction of an exact monthly workbook link without requesting the workbook
documenting the official public API methods, credential requirement, default rate limit, attribution, and terms without making a record request
fixture-tested bounded retrieval and structural ZIP/XML validation for the documented all-operations API method, with production execution disabled
immutable local retention of metadata-only preflight receipts
local-review-only normalization of an operator-supplied conformance-profile workbook after exact acknowledgement and source hash pinning
selection of Certified operations whose country identity is exact code USA and source label UNITED STATES OF AMERICA (THE), from a USDA NOP-scoped snapshot
preservation of certification effective date, certifier, NOP scope, service vocabulary, structured product taxonomy, and source-designated physical versus mailing address provenance
internal schema, foreign-key, privacy, temporal-semantics, and data-quality review
prohibited_use: live workbook body acquisition or claiming a verified official workbook sheet/header layout in this connector version
calling an Organic INTEGRITY API record endpoint, creating a data.gov credential, storing an API-key value in repository files, or treating a named credential reference as authorization
publication of current.json, registry admission, coverage admission, Heatmap admission, or production release
exporting contacts, phone numbers, email addresses, client identifiers, agents, people, websites, additional information, other-item free text, or varieties
accepting formulas, macros, ActiveX, embedded objects, external links, external relationships, merged cells, or workbook-defined names
joining ZIP5 and ZIP+4 into one canonical postal field
inventing coordinates, business geometry, physical sites, establishments, or general operating status
representing organic certification as independent proof of current sales, establishment activity, or general business operation
automatic entity resolution by name or address
attribution: Source: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, National Organic Program, Organic INTEGRITY Database. For API-backed services display prominently: This product uses USDA's Organic Integrity Database API but is not endorsed or certified by USDA. USDA or AMS logos must not be used to imply endorsement.
retention: Retain immutable metadata receipts and explicitly acknowledged run-scoped staging artifacts inside datahub until an approved retention operation. The operator source workbook is referenced by hash and not copied into staging.
redistribution: The authoritative catalog labels the dataset U.S. Public Domain, but this bounded connector exports records only for local review until source terms, required attribution, production admission, and field-level governance are separately approved.
personal_data_handling: The raw official workbook can contain contact names, phone/email, client identifiers, and residential addresses. The conformance input profile and normalized export exclude direct contact, phone, email, client, agent/person, website, additional-information, Other Item, and variety fields, but operation names and source addresses can still identify a person or residence. All normalized records remain local-review-only.
